cli

First-party Tiinex command-line host for portable Workspace, validation, Handoff, runtime and operator workflows.

Grounding boundary:
- Start from `.topics/.workspaces/tiinex-cli.workspace.md` and `.topics/reductions/workspace/010-cli-fresh-start-reduction.trace.md`.
- No pre-fresh-start CLI execution Task is current merely because historical material existed under an older refactor lineage; future CLI work starts from a new explicit bounded Task with truthful Project ancestry.
- Reuse public Core/Runtime/Provider/Interop contracts; do not copy shared Tooling or add provider/environment-specific branches merely to make a local command work.
- Treat repository source as implementation truth for the CLI host, not as authority for shared Tiinex semantics.
